metadata.review_note: Actual provider excerpt; local source-review acceptance

warnings: Native source review only. No portfolio returns, regression or currency conversion.
Dates are provider labels, not observed/published UTC timestamps. Retrieval does not prove historical availability; database vintage is not a publication timestamp.
Percentages divided by 100; only the declared -99.99 sentinel becomes null. No clipping, filling, resampling or dropping malformed rows.
Mkt-RF is an excess market factor; SMB/HML/RMW/CMA are spreads. RF retains the provider's USD trading-day construction; no second RF subtraction or compounding.
Gaps count absent calendar labels, not confirmed missing trading observations. A truncated file can pass structural checks; source completeness is not certified.
URL/origin and publication metadata are user declarations, not authentication. Retain source rights/provenance before wider redistribution or real-account use.
